_readme: Well-known sayings for the languages whose shipped dictionaries do not mark them.
Chinese is NOT here — CC-CEDICT tags 4,874 chengyu with '(idiom)' and real definitions,
so build-proverbs.mjs derives Chinese entirely from data and nothing is hand-written.
Japanese, Spanish and French get this file because their emitted dictionaries carry only
{p, m} — the proverb/idiom part-of-speech tags exist upstream in JMdict and Wiktionary but
are dropped when those tables are built, so there is nothing to filter on.
Written from knowledge of the languages, not copied from a list — the same standing as the
'beginner' sets in core-overrides.json, and for the same reason: the good curated
collections are unlicensed or commercially copyrighted. Every word is validated against our
own CC BY-SA dictionaries at build time, so a typo or an invented word fails the build.
'm' is what it means. 'l' is the literal reading, and is present only when it differs
enough to be worth seeing — a proverb whose charm is the image needs both.

ja.m: even an expert makes mistakes
fall down seven times, get up eight — persistence through setbacks

ja.r: いしのうえにもさんねん
ja.m: perseverance pays off in the end
ja.l: three years even on a rock

ja.m: substance over appearance
more haste, less speed
ja.l: if in a hurry, go around

ja.m: to each their own
to kill two birds with one stone
you reap what you sow
treasure every meeting, for it will never recur
an unspoken understanding between people
a dramatic recovery from a hopeless situation
adapting to the circumstances as they come

ja.r: ひゃくぶんはいっけんにしかず
ja.m: seeing once is better than hearing a hundred times

ja.t: 塵も積もれば山となる
ja.r: ちりもつもればやまとなる
ja.m: small things add up
ja.l: even dust piled up becomes a mountain

ja.m: you grow to love wherever you live
ja.l: if you live there, it is the capital

ja.t: 案ずるより産むが易し
ja.r: あんずるよりうむがやすし
ja.m: the anticipation is worse than the thing itself

ja.r: くちはわざわいのもと
ja.m: the mouth is the source of trouble
ignorance is bliss

ja.r: ふくすいぼんにかえらず
ja.m: what is done cannot be undone
ja.l: spilt water does not return to the tray

ja.r: そなえあればうれいなし
ja.m: if you are prepared, you need not worry

es.t: más vale tarde que nunca

es.t: no hay mal que por bien no venga

es.t: quien mucho duerme, poco aprende

es.t: no es oro todo lo que reluce

es.t: el hábito no hace al monje

es.t: ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente

es.t: más vale prevenir que curar

es.t: cada oveja con su pareja
es.m: birds of a feather flock together

es.t: de tal palo, tal astilla

es.t: no por mucho madrugar amanece más temprano

fr.t: petit à petit, l'oiseau fait son nid

fr.t: l'habit ne fait pas le moine

fr.t: qui vivra verra

fr.t: après la pluie, le beau temps

fr.t: c'est en forgeant qu'on devient forgeron

fr.t: il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu
fr.m: there is no smoke without fire

fr.t: chacun voit midi à sa porte
